content: Cloudflare's h3i (docs.rs/h3i, built on quiche) is direct design precedent: a low-level client/CLI explicitly built to 'bend RFC rules,' sending frames on any stream in any order with arbitrary legal-or-illegal content, to test server behavior against malformed input. No equivalent 'h2i' exists for HTTP/2 in Rust; hand-rolling a minimal raw frame writer bypassing the compliant high-level crate is proven prior art, not novel.
